primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: They traveled from Iyim, and encamped in Dibon Gad.

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 割当候補は「Iyim」だが、固定WEBPのNUM33:45は「Iye Abarim」と記す（「They traveled from Iye Abarim, and encamped in Dibon Gad.」）。IyimとIye Abarimがこの節で同一名・異形と断定できる独立根拠を得られず、候補IDを無理に接続しない。
